g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-401 Servo auger filler (built in house) · rev B
Product contact: 2B sheet, #4 polish Ra ≤ 0.8 µm [32 µin]; welds ground flush; passivate ASTM A967
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: SET J: AUGER IN TUBE (1:2), JAR / POUCH / TUB

g.text: M16 x 1.5 LH MALE x 25, shoulder Ø24
outlet: square cut, deburr, no lip

svg.text: DETAIL U (1:1): AUGER TOP END, SET J

g.text: optional: wire screen or spinner disc

svg.text: DOSE TABLE (blend 0.548 g/mL, fill efficiency 0.85; trim in calibration)
1. Supplier (All-Fill or equal) to quote with blend samples; confirm the fill efficiency and the clearance for a 0.54 g/mL free-flowing spice blend.
2. All product-contact surfaces Ra ≤ 0.8 µm, flights continuously welded and polished, no crevices; 316 / 316L with material certs (3.1).
3. Rotation when dosing: counter-clockwise seen from above. The RH flight then conveys down and the LH top thread self-tightens under load. Shoulder face seats on the spindle end.
4. The tube is a separate part with the 2.5 in TC ferrule; it fits the hopper outlet 403 with clamp P1-445. Mark set S / J on the ferrule.
5. Change-over: stop, lock out (Q1), clamp off, unscrew the auger (LH thread), tube down, fit the other set, set the stage stop (P1-401-700).
